name: Rock Creek Park Golf
architects: William S. Flynn (nine holes 1923, eighteen 1926); holes 3-8 rerouted by William F. Gordon after Military Road was widened (1957-58) (NPS, NCPC, cultural-landscapes.org)
boundary_name: Rock Creek Park Public Golf Course

dtm.source: District of Columbia (OCTO / DC GIS) lidar bare-earth DEM, 1 m, NAD83(HARN) / Maryland State Plane (EPSG:2804), metres; DC-wide file DC.TIF.2.tif from the developer (GitHub release data-washington-dc), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/clip_raster.py

chm.source: District of Columbia (OCTO / DC GIS) lidar normalized digital surface model (height above ground), 1 m, EPSG:2804, metres, water = -5; DC-wide file DC.TIF.1.tif from the developer (GitHub release data-washington-dc), clipped with pipeline/clip_raster.py
chm.label: DC lidar normalized surface model

world.note: bbox of the OSM course boundary (826 x 779 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (~227 m each side; Rock Creek and Beach Drive to the west, 16th Street to the east), 1,024 m north-south (~122 m each side; Military Road to the south)

scorecard_source: Printed course card (photo from the developer, 2026-10-22): 14 holes, par 50, White / Red / Yellow. Front nine and the 'back five' (the original 10, 11, 15, 17 and 18, played as 10-14 since the back nine's 12, 13, 14 and 16 closed in 2015). No rating or slope published. Conflicts on the card: the Red total is printed 3623 but the holes add to 3523 (front 2116 + back 1407); stroke index 8 appears twice (holes 2 and 14) and 6 not at all. GolfPass lists the same front nine.
attribution: Elevation and canopy: District of Columbia lidar 1 m DEM and normalized surface model, DC GIS / OCTO (CC BY 4.0)
Imagery for tracing: District of Columbia Orthophoto 2023, DC GIS / OCTO (CC BY 4.0)
Scorecard: Rock Creek Park Golf (National Links Trust)
notes: Built 2026-10-22 by a course chat. Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): White tees (no Blue on the card), all water red, OSM boundary as out of bounds, trees from lidar with fairway and tee-shot clearing, DC wind 2-10 mph. Theme piedmont, mid-autumn (developer, 2026-10-22). The 14-hole layout predates the 2024- renovation by National Links Trust; the lidar and the May 2023 orthophoto show it as built.
